pythonFunction.name: get_bill_line_items
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the line items of one bill: customer charge, distribution, purchased gas charge (PGC), budget
installment and, only on an account that carries one, the weather normalization line. Before calling this
tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    period: Billing period key such as 2026-10 (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, period, amount, line_items, fixed_charge and corrected_from.
